title.zh: ⚡️Kalshi拟融资约10亿美元，估值或达400亿美元
title.en: ⚡️Kalshi拟融资约10亿美元，估值或达400亿美元

current_state.zh: Kalshi is in advanced talks to raise roughly $1B at a ~$40B valuation, less than five months after a $1B round at $22B, as it expands beyond sports and election prediction markets toward a multi-asset platform and weighs a future IPO.
